# WISPs

A WISP (Wire Interoperability Specification Proposal) is a design document for one piece of Ghostly: a contract two apps agree on, an adapter that plugs into one, or a profile of wire behavior that already ships. Every WISP is a Draft, and its header says what is implemented and where. How a WISP is written, numbered and revised is in [WISP 00](00-process.md). The WISPs page on the site, [ghostly.tools/wisps](https://ghostly.tools/wisps), is generated from these files, so a change is made here and nowhere else.
